description: Rock Paper Scissors against the computer — best of 5, first to 3 round wins takes the match.

faqs.a: The computer picks uniformly at random each round. There's no pattern to learn — it's honest luck.
It's best-of-5: the first player to win 3 rounds wins the match. Drawn rounds don't count for either side.
Press R, P or S on your keyboard, or just tap the big buttons.

howto: Pick Rock, Paper or Scissors (or press R / P / S).
The computer picks at the same time.
Round winner and running score update live.
First to 3 round wins takes the match — then play again.
title: Rock Paper Scissors
